awards.title: RoboMaster 2025 (Zhejiang) 🏆 First Prize (Runner-up)
awards.organization: DJI RoboMaster, co-hosted by CYL Central Committee, National Union of Students & Shenzhen Municipal Government
awards.description: As team captain of WHU LuojiaFox, led Wuhan University to its first-ever RM provincial first prize. Multi-robot autonomous localization, navigation and vision-based target tracking for tactical combat.

awards.title: China Robotics & AI Contest – Smart-Home 🏆 Champion
awards.description: Team captain representing WHU Engineering Practice & Innovation Club in its debut; autonomous grasping & QR-code-based sorting of household items.

awards.title: RAICOM Fruit-Eye Challenge 🏆 First Prize (Runner-up)
awards.organization: Ministry of Industry & Information Technology Talent Center
awards.description: As captain, led fully-autonomous fruit detection, ripeness recognition and robotic harvesting into designated bins.

awards.title: Intelligent-Robot Contest – Rubik’s Robot 🥈 2nd Prize
awards.organization: Zhejiang University Robotics Institute & Yuyao Municipal Government
awards.description: Team captain; first time WHU reached the finals. Dual-arm robot solving 3×3 Rubik’s cube as fast as possible.
